lenders.name: International Finance Corporation (IFC)
lenders.role: Board approved a US$90 million corporate loan on 8 March 2007 (project 23792), signed June 2007, for Bertin's investment programme; IFC's review covered expanding its Marabá meat plant in Pará. Greenpeace said US$60 million had been paid out when IFC withdrew in June 2009, that the last US$30 million would not be given, and that IFC was expected to ask for early repayment.

companies.name: Bertin
companies.role: Brazil's second-largest meat processing company (IFC); owner of the Marabá slaughterhouse
